thread:
ashley: Quick sync — packaging roadmap draft uploaded to GDrive. Need to lock final launch criteria for Private (VPC / on-prem) by EOD Wed. Top customer asks we need to resolve: customer-managed BGP peering, airgap/offline installer parity, and a nondisruptive upgrade path for tenant networks. Any blockers?
vikram: I skimmed the doc. main infra risk is the BGP handoff config surface — needs a minimal prescriptive config or we’ll get 10 different flavors from field. recommend a single 'presets.yml' with 3 supported topologies.
sara: from field: customers want explicit rollback steps for upgrades; they hate partial tenant ejection. can we promise <5m control-plane switchovers? maybe make that a launch 'soft' SLO rather than hard SLA.
tony: BGP prescriptive is fine but netops wants a clear failure mode: if peer rejects routes we should fallback to relay mode. + documentation snippet for troubleshooting. also suggest we require IP preservation in upgrade window.
jen: solutions team: customer-managed KMS + HSM ask is surfacing more. is that in scope for MVP or a follow-on? shipping without KMS/HSM support will block a few finance customers.
avatar: deploy-bot popped in: nightly-build (private-installer) passed — 1767001200. artifacts at ci.redwood/internal/priv-installer/1767001200
vikram: jen — KMS/HSM can be follow-on for initial GA if we mark it as "enterprise optional" behind a policy gate. but we should ship a clear compatibility matrix in docs.
ashley: decision proposal: 1) Launch criteria = (a) BGP presets + relay fallback documented, (b) offline installer parity for core runtime (telemetry/KMS incremental), (c) upgrade path with documented rollback and <15m control-plane guidance, (d) field-run checklist for IP preservation. 2) KMS/HSM labeled enterprise delayed feature. 3) Add an opt-in canary for tenant upgrades. good?
sara: sounds pragmatic. are we tracking exact test cases? e.g. "tenant egress preserved after upgrade" and "peer rejects routes and relay engages". those need automation.
vikram: I'll own automation tests for the BGP and relay scenarios. scope: 4 tests, run in CI + nightly staging. ETA: 2 sprints.
jen: Solutions will own customer comms + gating language for KMS deferred. I'll whip up message templates and update the sales playbook.
tony: ops will draft the troubleshooting runbook and the packet captures checklist. will try to get a first pass by Tue.
ashley: ok owners set. action items: vikram -> presets.yml proposal PR by Mon; tony -> runbook draft Tue; jen -> comms + playbook Tue; sara -> add automation test stubs to repo; ashley -> update launch criteria doc and notify launches channel.
vikram: one more ask — for nondisruptive upgrades we need KV cache migration semantics documented. putting short snippet in the PR: ```migration_mode: streaming_kv; max_block_ms: 500```
sara: noted, will add tests for max_block_ms enforcement.
deploy-bot: smoke-tests (staging) queued 1767001275 — will post results.
ashley: thanks all. if no objections I’ll mark this as the product steering decision and update the roadmap accordingly. :thumbsup:
vikram: :thumbsup:
jen: :thumbsup:
tony: +1
sara: +1
